translations.literal: Biography 19 ○ Hu Moupa, Di Gudie, A Tuhan, Jia Gu Xienu, Aleigen Meidoulu, Huangguai Diguben, Pucha Huzhan, Jiagu Wulibu, Wang Bolong, Gao Biao, Wendihan Pulite, Bode Telibu, Yelü Huaiyi, Xiao Wangjianu, Tian Hao, Zhao Wei
translations.idiomatic: Biography 19: Hu Moupa, Di Gudie, A Tuhan, Jia Gu Xienu, Aleigen Meidoulu, Huangguai Diguben, Pucha Huzhan, Jiagu Wulibu, Wang Bolong, Gao Biao, Wendihan Pulite, Bode Telibu, Yelü Huaiyi, Xiao Wangjianu, Tian Hao, and Zhao Wei

sentences.zh: 鶻謀琶

translations.literal: Hu Moupa
translations.idiomatic: Hu Moupa

sentences.zh: 鶻謀琶，術吉水斜卯部人也。

translations.literal: Hu Moupa was a man of the Xiemao clan of the Shujishui region.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Moupa was of the Xiemao clan of the Shujishui region.

sentences.zh: 性忠直寬厚，重節義，勇於戰。

translations.literal: By nature he was loyal, upright, generous, and broad-minded; he treasured integrity and righteousness and was bold in battle.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was loyal, upright, and generous; he prized integrity and fought boldly.

sentences.zh: 父阿鶻土，贈金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: His father Ahetu was posthumously granted General-in-Chief of the Jinwu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ahetu was posthumously made General-in-Chief of the Jinwu Guard.

sentences.zh: 穆宗時，鶻謀琶內附，先遣子甯吉從間道送款。

translations.literal: During Muzong's reign, Hu Moupa submitted to allegiance; he first sent his son Ningji by a concealed route to offer submission.
translations.idiomatic: During Muzong's reign Hu Moupa came over to the Jin side, first sending his son Ningji by a hidden route to pledge allegiance.

sentences.zh: 遂使活里疃與鶻謀琶合軍攻降諸部，因領其眾，與弟胡麻谷、渾坦、侄阿里等攻下諸城，從撒改破塢塔城，穆宗屢賞之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Huolizhuan was sent to join forces with Hu Moupa to attack and bring the various tribes to submission; he then led their masses, and together with his younger brothers Humagu and Huntan and his nephew Ali and others captured various cities; following Sa Gai he took Wuta city, and Muzong rewarded him repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Huolizhuan was then sent to join Hu Moupa in attacking and subduing the tribes. He took command of their followers and, with his younger brothers Humagu and Huntan and his nephew Ali, captured a series of towns. Following Sa Gai he took Wuta, and Muzong rewarded him again and again.

sentences.zh: 破高麗戍兵。

translations.literal: He defeated Goryeo garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Goryeo frontier garrisons.

sentences.zh: 與石適歡討平諸部。

translations.literal: Together with Shi Shihuan he pacified the various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: With Shi Shihuan he pacified the remaining tribes.

sentences.zh: 蒲察部雅里孛堇與其兄弟胡八、雙括等欲叛歸遼，鶻謀琶執之，送于康宗，賜賚甚厚。

translations.literal: Yali boliezhen of the Pucha tribe and his brothers Hu Ba, Shuangkuo, and others wished to rebel and return to Liao; Hu Moupa seized them and sent them to Kang Zong, who bestowed rewards most generously.
translations.idiomatic: Yali, boliezhen of the Pucha tribe, and his brothers Hu Ba and Shuangkuo planned to rebel and rejoin Liao. Hu Moupa seized them and sent them to Kang Zong, who rewarded him lavishly.

sentences.zh: 破高麗曷懶甸及下陀魯城有功。

translations.literal: He had merit in defeating [the enemy] in Goryeo's Yilanshan region and in taking Xiatuolu city.
translations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself in fighting Goryeo in the Yilan region and in capturing Xiatuolu.

sentences.zh: 天輔六年卒，年七十二。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu he died, aged seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year of Tianfu (1122), aged seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 天眷中，贈銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: During Tianjuan he was posthumously granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianjuan era (1138–1141) he was posthumously made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Silver Seal.

sentences.zh: 迪姑迭

translations.literal: Di Gudie
translations.idiomatic: Di Gudie

sentences.zh: 迪姑迭，溫蒂罕部人。

translations.literal: Di Gudie was a man of the Wendihan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Di Gudie was of the Wendihan tribe.

sentences.zh: 祖紮古乃，父阿胡迭，世為胡論水部長。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhagunai; his father Ahudie—for generations they had been chiefs of the Hulunshui tribe.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Zhagunai and his father Ahudie; for generations their line had headed the Hulunshui tribe.

sentences.zh: 迪姑迭年二十余代領父謀克，攻甯江州，敗遼援兵，獲甲馬財物。

translations.literal: When Di Gudie was a little over twenty he acted in his father's stead as mouke; he attacked Ningjiang Prefecture, defeated Liao relief troops, and obtained armor, horses, and goods.
translations.idiomatic: In his early twenties Di Gudie acted in his father's place as mouke, attacked Ningjiang, routed Liao reinforcements, and seized armor, horses, and supplies.

sentences.zh: 攻破奚營，回至韓州，遇敵二千人，擊走之。

translations.literal: He stormed and took Xi camps; returning to Hanzhou, he encountered two thousand enemy troops and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed Xi encampments and, on returning to Hanzhou, met two thousand enemy troops and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 斡魯古與遼人戰於鹹州，兵已卻，迪姑迭以本部兵力戰，諸軍複振，遂大破之。

translations.literal: Wolugu fought the Liao at Xianzhou; the army had already retreated, but Di Gudie fought on with his own command, the armies rallied again, and thus won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: At Xianzhou Wolugu's army had already begun to withdraw when Di Gudie fought on with his own command. The other units rallied, and together they won a great victory over the Liao.

sentences.zh: 護步答岡之役，乙里補孛堇陷敵中，迪姑迭援出之。

translations.literal: At the battle of Hubudagang, boliezhen Yilibu was trapped among the enemy; Di Gudie rescued him.
translations.idiomatic: At Hubudagang, boliezhen Yilibu was surrounded by the enemy; Di Gudie fought his way in and brought him out.

sentences.zh: 攻黃龍府，身被數創，授猛安。

translations.literal: In the assault on Huanglong Prefecture, he suffered numerous wounds and was appointed meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Huanglong he took many wounds and was made a meng'an.

sentences.zh: 天輔七年，從上至山西，病卒，年四十七。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianfu, while following the emperor to Shanxi, he died of illness, aged forty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianfu (1123), while accompanying the emperor into Shanxi, he died of illness at forty-seven.

sentences.zh: 天眷中，贈光祿大夫。

translations.literal: During Tianjuan he was posthumously granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianjuan he was posthumously made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 阿徒罕

translations.literal: A Tuhan
translations.idiomatic: A Tuhan

sentences.zh: 阿徒罕，溫蒂罕部人。

translations.literal: A Tuhan was a man of the Wendihan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: A Tuhan was of the Wendihan tribe.

sentences.zh: 年十七從撒改、斡帶等討平諸部，皆身先力戰。

translations.literal: At age seventeen he followed Sa Gai, Wodai, and others to pacify the various tribes, always taking the lead and fighting with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: At seventeen he followed Sa Gai, Wodai, and others in pacifying the tribes, always fighting at the front.

sentences.zh: 高麗築九城於曷懶甸，斡塞禦之，阿徒罕為前鋒。

translations.literal: Goryeo built nine cities in Yilanshan; Wo Sai resisted them, and A Tuhan served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Goryeo built nine fortresses in the Yilan region, Wo Sai led the defense and A Tuhan served as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 高麗有屯於海島者，阿徒罕率眾三十人夜渡，焚其營柵戰艦，大破之，遂下陀吉城。

translations.literal: Goryeo had encampments on offshore islands; A Tuhan led thirty men across by night, burned their camps, palisades, and warships, routed them utterly, and then took Tuoji city.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo had troops stationed on offshore islands. A Tuhan took thirty men across by night, burned their camps, palisades, and warships, routed them completely, and then took Tuoji.

sentences.zh: 既而八城皆下，功最。

translations.literal: Thereafter eight cities all fell, and his merit was greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Eight of the nine cities soon fell, and his merit ranked first.

sentences.zh: 遼兵自甯江州東門出，阿徒罕逆擊，盡殪之，以功授謀克。

translations.literal: Liao troops came out from the east gate of Ningjiang Prefecture; A Tuhan met and attacked them, annihilating them all, and for this merit was appointed mouke.
translations.idiomatic: When Liao troops sallied from the east gate of Ningjiang, A Tuhan met them head-on and annihilated them, and for this he was made a mouke.

sentences.zh: 從攻黃龍府，力戰，身被數十創，竟登其城。

translations.literal: In the assault on Huanglong Prefecture he fought fiercely, his body bearing dozens of wounds, yet in the end he climbed its walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Huanglong he fought fiercely, his body bearing dozens of wounds, yet he still scaled the walls.

sentences.zh: 後與烏論石准援照散城，阿徒罕請乘不備急擊之，遂夜過益褪水，詰朝，大敗之。

translations.literal: Later, with Ulun Shizhun he reinforced Zhaosan city; A Tuhan requested to strike while the enemy was unprepared, and thus that night they crossed the Yituishui; at dawn they utterly defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Later, reinforcing Zhaosan with Ulun Shizhun, A Tuhan urged a surprise attack. That night they crossed the Yituishui, and at dawn they routed the enemy completely.

sentences.zh: 斡魯上其功，賜幣與馬。

translations.literal: Wolu reported his merit, and he was rewarded with silk and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Wolu reported his achievements, and he was rewarded with silk and horses.

sentences.zh: 天輔四年五月疾病，賜良馬一匹，詔曰：「汝安則乘之。」

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Tianfu he fell ill; a fine horse was bestowed on him, and an edict said: "If you recover, then ride it."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Tianfu (1120) he fell ill. The court gave him a fine horse and issued an edict: "If you recover, then ride it."

sentences.zh: 年六十五卒。

translations.literal: He died aged sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 上悼惜之，遣使弔祭，以馬為贈。

translations.literal: The emperor mourned him and sent envoys to offer condolences; the horse was given as a funerary gift.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him, sent envoys to offer condolences, and gave him the horse as a burial gift.

sentences.zh: 阿徒罕為人孝弟，好施惠，健捷善弋獵，至角牴、擊鞠，鹹精其能。

translations.literal: A Tuhan as a man was filial and fraternal, fond of bestowing favors, vigorous and nimble and skilled at archery and hunting—even in wrestling and cuju he excelled at all.
translations.idiomatic: A Tuhan was filial and generous, quick and strong, and skilled at archery and hunting; he was also expert at wrestling and cuju.

sentences.zh: 夾谷謝奴

translations.literal: Jia Gu Xienu
translations.idiomatic: Jia Gu Xienu

sentences.zh: 夾谷謝奴，隆州納魯悔河人也。

translations.literal: Jia Gu Xienu was a native of Naluheihui River in Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Gu Xienu was from the Naluheihui River region in Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 國初，祖阿海率所部來歸，獻器用甲仗。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, his grandfather Ahai led his following to submit and presented utensils, armor, and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty his grandfather Ahai led their band in submission and presented utensils, armor, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 父不剌速，襲本部勃堇，從太祖伐遼，授世襲猛安，親管謀克，為曷懶路都統。

translations.literal: His father Bulasu inherited the tribal boliezhen of their division; following the Taizu emperor in the campaign against Liao, he was appointed hereditary meng'an with personal charge of moukes and made commander-in-chief of the Yilan Route.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bulasu inherited the tribal boliezhen of their division. He followed Taizu against Liao, received a hereditary meng'an with personal charge of moukes, and became commander-in-chief of the Yilan Route.

sentences.zh: 謝奴其長子也，長身多髯，善騎射，通女直、契丹大小字及漢字。

translations.literal: Xienu was his eldest son—tall in stature, heavily bearded, skilled at horseback archery, versed in Jurchen, Khitan, both large and small scripts, and Chinese characters.
translations.idiomatic: Xienu was his eldest son—tall and heavily bearded, skilled at mounted archery, and versed in Jurchen, Khitan large and small scripts, and Chinese.

sentences.zh: 既冠，隨其父見太祖，命佩金牌，總領左翼護衛。

translations.literal: After coming of age he accompanied his father to an audience with Taizu, who ordered him to wear a gold tablet and take overall charge of the Left Wing Guard.
translations.idiomatic: After he came of age he accompanied his father to an audience with Taizu, who ordered him to wear a gold tablet and take command of the Left Wing Guard.

sentences.zh: 西京未下，謝奴獲城中生口，乃知城中潛遣人求救於外，都統府得為之備，卻其救兵，西京乃下。

translations.literal: When the Western Capital had not yet fallen, Xienu captured live prisoners from within the city and thus learned that the city had secretly sent men to seek outside relief; the commander-in-chief's office was able to prepare against it, repelled the relief force, and the Western Capital then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Western Capital fell, Xienu took prisoners from inside the city and learned that it had secretly sent men to seek outside help. The commander-in-chief's office was able to prepare, repelled the relief force, and the city then fell.

sentences.zh: 自燕京還，過判泥恩納阿，遇敵於隘。

translations.literal: Returning from Yanjing, while passing Panien'a, they met the enemy in a narrow pass.
translations.idiomatic: On the return from Yanjing, while passing Panien'a, they met the enemy in a narrow defile.

sentences.zh: 謝奴身先士卒，射殺敵中先鋒二人，敵潰走，總管蒲魯虎以甲及馬贈之。

translations.literal: Xienu took the lead among the troops, shot and killed two of the enemy vanguard, the enemy scattered and fled, and Commander-in-Chief Puluhu rewarded him with armor and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Xienu led from the front, shot down two enemy vanguard leaders, and put the rest to flight. Commander-in-Chief Puluhu rewarded him with armor and horses.

sentences.zh: 後領其父猛安，從攻和尚原，出仙人關。

translations.literal: Later he inherited his father's meng'an and followed the attack on Heshangyuan, passing out through Xianren Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Later he inherited his father's meng'an and took part in the attack on Heshangyuan, advancing through Xianren Pass.

sentences.zh: 宋兵據險，猛安雛訛只突戰不克，謝奴選麾下五十人戰，克之。

translations.literal: Song troops held the heights; meng'an Chuzhuo'azhi charged but could not take it—Xienu selected fifty men under his command to fight and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops held the high ground. Meng'an Chuzhuo'azhi led a charge but could not break them; Xienu chose fifty men from his command, attacked, and took the position.

sentences.zh: 與吳玠相拒，烏里雅行陣不整，吳玠乘之，謝奴領兵逆戰，遂大破敵。

translations.literal: Opposing Wu Jie, at Wuliya the formation was not orderly; Wu Jie seized the opportunity—Xienu led troops to meet him in battle and utterly routed the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Facing Wu Jie, the Jin line at Wuliya fell into disorder and Wu Jie seized the moment. Xienu led his troops to meet the attack head-on and routed the enemy completely.

sentences.zh: 計前後功，襲其父猛安謀克。

translations.literal: Considering his merits before and after, he inherited his father's meng'an and mouke.
translations.idiomatic: In recognition of his cumulative service he inherited his father's meng'an and mouke.

sentences.zh: 宗弼複取河南、陝西，宋人欲潛兵襲取石閏諸營，謝奴自渭南大禹鎮掩其伏兵，射中其軍帥，宋兵敗走，多獲旗幟兵仗，帥府厚賞之。

translations.literal: Zongbi again took Henan and Shaanxi; the Song intended to send troops secretly to seize the Shiying camps—Xienu from Weinan's Dayu town covered their ambush, shot and hit their army commander, the Song army fled in defeat, and they captured many banners, flags, and weapons; the headquarters rewarded him richly.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongbi retook Henan and Shaanxi, the Song planned a stealth attack on the Shiying camps. From Dayu in Weinan, Xienu fell on their ambush, shot their commander, and drove them off, capturing many banners and weapons. Headquarters rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 除華州防禦使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Defender of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Defender of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 入為工部侍郎，遷本部尚書。

translations.literal: He entered court as Vice Minister of Works and was transferred to Minister of the same department.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the central government as Vice Minister of Works and was promoted to Minister of that department.

sentences.zh: 改平涼尹、昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was changed to Intendant of Pingliang and military governor of Zhaoyijun.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Intendant of Pingliang and military governor of Zhaoyijun.

sentences.zh: 大定初，卒。

translations.literal: Early in the Dading era he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died early in the Dading era (1161–1189).

sentences.zh: 阿勒根沒都魯

translations.literal: Aleigen Meidoulu
translations.idiomatic: Aleigen Meidoulu

sentences.zh: 阿勒根沒都魯，上京納鄰河人也，後徙咸平路梅黑河。

translations.literal: Aleigen Meidoulu was a native of Nalin River in Shangjing; later he moved to Meihei River in the Xianping Route.
translations.idiomatic: Aleigen Meidoulu was from Nalin River in Shangjing and later moved to Meihei River in the Xianping Route.

sentences.zh: 雄偉美須髯，勇毅善射。

translations.literal: He was imposing, with a handsome beard; brave, resolute, and skilled at archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was imposing, with a fine beard, and was brave, resolute, and skilled at archery.

sentences.zh: 國初伐遼，沒都魯在軍中，領謀克猛安，每遇敵，往來馳突，人莫敢當，故所戰皆克。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state in the campaign against Liao, Meidoulu was in the army leading mouke-meng'an forces. Whenever he met the enemy he charged back and forth; none dared stand against him, and therefore he won every battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the founding campaign against Liao, Meidoulu served in the army as a mouke-meng'an leader. Whenever he met the enemy he charged to and fro, and none dared stand against him; he won every engagement.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，計功擢宣威將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong, his merit was reckoned and he was promoted to Extending Prestige General.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangtong his merit was reckoned and he was promoted to extending prestige general.

sentences.zh: 明年，授同知通遠軍節度使，改移剌都抃詳穩。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed associate military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army and changed to xiangwen of Yila Dubian.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he became associate military commissioner of the Tongyuan Army and was made xiangwen of Yila Dubian.

sentences.zh: 授世襲本路寧打渾河謀克。

translations.literal: He was granted hereditary mouke of the Ningda Hunhe on this route.
translations.idiomatic: He received hereditary mouke of Ningda Hunhe on this route.

sentences.zh: 為滑州刺史，改肇州防禦使、蒲與路節度使，遷驃騎上將軍。

translations.literal: He served as prefect of Hua Prefecture, was changed to defender of Zhaozhou and military commissioner of the Puyu Route, and was transferred to Cavalry General-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He became prefect of Hua Prefecture, then defender of Zhaozhou and military commissioner of the Puyu Route, and rose to cavalry general-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 累官金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Through successive offices he reached General-in-Chief of the Jinwu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to general-in-chief of the Jinwu Guard.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以年老致仕，卒。

translations.literal: That year, on account of old age he retired from office and died.
translations.idiomatic: That year he retired on account of age and died.

sentences.zh: 年七十三。

translations.literal: He was seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: He was seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 黃摑敵古本

translations.literal: Huangguai Diguben
translations.idiomatic: Huangguai Diguben

sentences.zh: 黃摑敵古本，世居星顯水。

translations.literal: Huangguai Diguben had long resided at Xingxianshui.
translations.idiomatic: Huangguai Diguben's family had long lived on the Xingxian River.

sentences.zh: 從破甯江，取咸州，平東京路及諸山寨柵，皆有功。

translations.literal: Following the capture of Ningjiang, taking Xianzhou, pacifying the Eastern Capital Route and the various mountain stockades and palisades—at all he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself in the capture of Ningjiang, the taking of Xianzhou, and the pacification of the Eastern Capital Route and its mountain stockades.

sentences.zh: 從麻吉破遼將和尚節使兵七千於上京，複破那野軍二萬。

translations.literal: Following Maji he defeated seven thousand troops of the Liao general Heshang the commissioner at Shangjing, and again defeated Nayue's army of twenty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Following Maji he helped defeat seven thousand troops under the Liao commissioner Heshang at Shangjing and later routed Nayue's army of twenty thousand.

sentences.zh: 再從麻吉遇敵于阿鄰甸，麻吉被創，不能戰，敵古本率兵擊敗之，剿殺殆盡。

translations.literal: Again following Maji, they met the enemy at Ayindian; Maji was wounded and could not fight—Diguben led troops to defeat them and almost exterminated them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Maji he met the enemy at Ayindian. Maji was wounded and unable to fight, but Diguben led the troops to victory and nearly wiped the enemy out.

sentences.zh: 從攻回鶻城，破其兵九萬，敗木匠直撒兵於山后，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the assault on the Uighur city he routed their army of ninety thousand and defeated the Mozhang straight-sa troops in the mountains behind, capturing very many.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on the Uighur city he routed an army of ninety thousand and defeated the Mozhang straight-sa force in the rear hills, taking a great number of captives.

sentences.zh: 敗昭古牙之兵三千，獲其家屬而還。

translations.literal: He defeated Zhaoguya's army of three thousand and returned with their families captive.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Zhaoguya's force of three thousand and returned with their families as captives.

sentences.zh: 攻平州張覺，吾春被圍於西山，敵古本引兵救之，解其圍，並獲糧五千斛，招降戶口甚眾。

translations.literal: Attacking Zhang Jue of Pingzhou, Wuchun was besieged at Xishan—Diguben led troops to rescue him, lifted the siege, and also obtained five thousand hu of grain, inducing very many households to submit.
translations.idiomatic: During the attack on Zhang Jue of Pingzhou, Wuchun was besieged on Xishan. Diguben led troops to relieve him, lifted the siege, seized five thousand hu of grain, and induced many households to submit.

sentences.zh: 從平興中，撫安其民人。

translations.literal: Following the pacification of Xingzhong, he pacified and reassured its people.
translations.idiomatic: After the pacification of Xingzhong he reassured the local population.

sentences.zh: 天會間，大軍伐宋，敵古本從取浚、開德、大名，及取濟南、高唐、棣、密等州。

translations.literal: During the Tianhui period, the great army campaigned against Song; Diguben followed in taking Xun, Kaide, Daming, and in taking Jinan, Gaotang, Di, Mi, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianhui era (1123–1137) he followed the great campaign against Song, helping take Xun, Kaide, and Daming, and later Jinan, Gaotang, Di, Mi, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 皇統間，以功襲謀克，移屯于壽光縣界為千戶。

translations.literal: During Huangtong, for merit he inherited the mouke and was transferred to encamp on the border of Shouguang County as a thousand-household chief.
translations.idiomatic: During Huangtong (1141–1149) he inherited a mouke for his service and was stationed on the Shouguang border as a thousand-household chief.

sentences.zh: 六年，授世襲千戶，棣州防禦使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was appointed hereditary thousand-household chief and Defender of Di Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he received a hereditary thousand-household post and was made Defender of Di Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 蒲察胡盞

translations.literal: Pucha Huzhan
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Huzhan

sentences.zh: 蒲察胡盞，案出滸水人。

translations.literal: Pucha Huzhan was a man of Anchuchishui.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Huzhan was from the Anchuchishui region.

sentences.zh: 年十八從軍，其父特廝死，襲為謀克。

translations.literal: At eighteen he entered the army; when his father Tesi died, he inherited the mouke.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the army at eighteen. When his father Tesi died, he inherited the mouke.

sentences.zh: 天輔間，夏以兵三萬出天德路，胡盞從婁室迎戰，以兵三百敗敵二千。

translations.literal: During Tianfu, Xia sent thirty thousand troops out the Tiande Route; Huzhan followed Wushi in meeting them in battle and with three hundred troops defeated two thousand of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianfu, Xia sent thirty thousand troops along the Tiande route. Huzhan followed Wushi to meet them and, with three hundred men, defeated two thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 天會三年，大軍攻太原，城中出兵萬余來戰，胡盞以所領千戶軍擊之，複敗敵兵三萬余於榆次境。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianhui the great army attacked Taiyuan; more than ten thousand from within the city came out to fight—Huzhan with the thousand-household army under his command struck them, and again defeated more than thirty thousand enemy troops in the borders of Yuci.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianhui (1125) the main army attacked Taiyuan. More than ten thousand troops sallied from the city; Huzhan struck them with his thousand-household command and later routed more than thirty thousand enemy troops in Yuci.

sentences.zh: 六年，從婁室攻京兆，以所部兵屢與宋人接戰，皆先登有功。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following Wushi in the assault on Jingzhao, his troops repeatedly engaged the Song in battle and always took the lead with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Wushi in the assault on Jingzhao. His troops repeatedly clashed with the Song and always led the assault with distinction.

sentences.zh: 七年，取邠州，遇宋人二十余萬，我軍右翼少卻。

translations.literal: In the seventh year they took Binzhou; they met more than two hundred thousand Song troops, and our army's right wing retreated somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year they took Binzhou and met more than two hundred thousand Song troops. The Jin right wing gave ground slightly.

sentences.zh: 時胡盞為左翼千戶，摧鋒陷陣，敵遂敗去。

translations.literal: At that time Huzhan was a thousand-household chief on the left wing; he crushed the vanguard and broke the enemy formation, and the enemy then fled.
translations.idiomatic: Huzhan was then a thousand-household chief on the left wing. He smashed the enemy vanguard, broke their line, and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 敗張浚富平復有功。

translations.literal: Defeating Zhang Jun at Fuping he again had merit.
translations.idiomatic: He again distinguished himself in the defeat of Zhang Jun at Fuping.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擊關師古於臨洮眾三萬餘。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he struck Guan Shigu at Lintao—a force of more than thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he attacked Guan Shigu at Lintao, where the enemy numbered more than thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 從攻涇州，從破德順、秦、鞏、臨洮、河、蘭等州，破吳璘兵，胡盞皆有力焉。

translations.literal: In the assault on Jingzhou, in taking Dehun, Qin, Gong, Lintao, He, Lan, and other prefectures, and in routing Wu Lin's troops—at all of these Huzhan exerted himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Jingzhou and the capture of Dehun, Qin, Gong, Lintao, He, Lan, and other prefectures, and in the defeat of Wu Lin's army, Huzhan played a leading part throughout.

sentences.zh: 授德順州刺史，改隴州防禦使。

translations.literal: He was appointed Prefect of Dehun and changed to Defender of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Prefect of Dehun and later Defender of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔尹。

translations.literal: Intendant of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He became Intendant of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 卒，年五十五。

translations.literal: He died, aged fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: He died at fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 夾穀吾里補

translations.literal: Jiagu Wulibu
translations.idiomatic: Jiagu Wulibu

sentences.zh: 夾穀吾里補，暗土渾河人，徙天德。

translations.literal: Jiagu Wulibu was a man of the An'tuhun River; he moved to Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: Jiagu Wulibu was from the An'tuhun River region and later moved to Tiande.

sentences.zh: 父兀屯，討烏春、窩謀罕有功。

translations.literal: His father Wutun had merit in campaigns against Wuchun and Wonanghan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wutun distinguished himself in campaigns against Wuchun and Wonanghan.

sentences.zh: 吾里補隸婁室帳下，攻系遼女直，招降太彎照三等。

translations.literal: Wulibu was attached to Wushi's command; he attacked subordinate Liao Jurchen, inducing Taiwan Zhaosan and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Wulibu served under Wushi, attacked Jurchen bands still loyal to Liao, and induced Taiwan Zhaosan and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 從婁室救斡魯古於鹹州，敗遼兵于押魯虎城。

translations.literal: Following Wushi to rescue Wolugu at Xianzhou, they defeated Liao troops at Yaluhu city.
translations.idiomatic: Following Wushi to relieve Wolugu at Xianzhou, he helped defeat Liao troops at Yaluhu.

sentences.zh: 遼軍營遼水，吾里補五謀克軍乘夜擊之，遼軍驚潰，殺獲幾盡。

translations.literal: Liao troops encamped on the Liao River; Wulibu with five mouke armies struck them by night—the Liao army was startled and scattered, and nearly all were killed or captured.
translations.idiomatic: When Liao troops camped on the Liao River, Wulibu led five mouke units in a night attack. The Liao army broke in panic and was nearly annihilated.

sentences.zh: 斡魯伐高永昌，吾里補以數騎奮擊于遼水之上，複以四十騎伏於津要，遇其候騎，擊之，獲生口，因盡知永昌虛實。

translations.literal: Wolu campaigned against Gao Yongchang; Wulibu with several horsemen fought fiercely on the Liao River, and again with forty horsemen lay in ambush at a crossing; encountering their scout horsemen he struck them, captured prisoners alive, and thereby knew Yongchang's situation in full.
translations.idiomatic: When Wolu campaigned against Gao Yongchang, Wulibu charged with a few horsemen on the Liao River, then ambushed a crossing with forty riders, struck Yongchang's scouts, and took prisoners who revealed the enemy's full situation.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘉之，賞奴婢八人。

translations.literal: Taizu praised him and rewarded him with eight male and female slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu praised him and rewarded him with eight slaves.

sentences.zh: 永昌駐軍於兔兒陀，先據津要，軍不得渡。

translations.literal: Yongchang stationed troops at Tu'ertuo, seizing the crossing first so the army could not ford.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang held Tu'ertuo and seized the crossing first, blocking the Jin army from fording.

sentences.zh: 吾里補與撒八射殺其先鋒二人，永昌眾稍卻，大軍遂渡遼水。

translations.literal: Wulibu with Sabo shot and killed two of their vanguard; Yongchang's masses retreated somewhat, and the great army then crossed the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: Wulibu and Sabo shot down two enemy vanguard leaders. Yongchang's force gave ground, and the main army crossed the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 及攻廣甯，軍帥選勇士先登，吾里補與赤盞忽沒渾各領所部，突入其陣，大軍繼之，遂拔廣寧。

translations.literal: When they attacked Guangning, the army commander selected brave warriors to climb first—Wulibu with Chizhan Humen each led their commands, burst into the enemy formation, the great army followed, and thus they took Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Guangning the commander chose warriors for the first ascent. Wulibu and Chizhan Humen each led their units into the enemy line, the main force followed, and Guangning fell.

sentences.zh: 太祖攻臨潢，吾里補面被重創，奮擊自若，賞以遼宮女二人。

translations.literal: Taizu assaulted Linhuang; Wulibu's face bore heavy wounds yet he struck fiercely as before, and was rewarded with two Liao palace women.
translations.idiomatic: At Taizu's assault on Linhuang, Wulibu's face was badly wounded, yet he fought on as fiercely as before and was rewarded with two women from the Liao palace.

sentences.zh: 遼王杲已取中京，吾里補以四十騎覘敵，獲遼喉舌人，因知遼主所在。

translations.literal: Liao Prince Gao had already taken Zhongjing; Wulibu with forty horsemen reconnoitered the enemy, captured a Liao spokesman, and thereby learned where the Liao emperor was.
translations.idiomatic: After Liao Prince Gao took Zhongjing, Wulibu reconnoitered with forty horsemen, captured a Liao spokesman, and learned the Liao emperor's whereabouts.

sentences.zh: 後從都統斡魯定雲中，從宗翰屯應州，遼軍在近境，吾里補以所部擊敗之。

translations.literal: Later, following Commander-in-Chief Wolu to secure Yunzhong, following Zonghan in garrison at Yingzhou—Liao troops were near the borders; Wulibu with his command defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Commander-in-Chief Wolu in securing Yunzhong and Zonghan in garrison at Yingzhou. When Liao troops approached the border, Wulibu defeated them with his command.

sentences.zh: 宗望伐宋，宋安撫使蔡靖詣吾里補降。

translations.literal: Zongwang campaigned against Song; Song Pacification Commissioner Cai Jing came to Wulibu to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Song Pacification Commissioner Cai Jing came to Wulibu to surrender.

sentences.zh: 婁室攻陝西，諸郡往往復叛，吾里補攻敗之。

translations.literal: Wushi assaulted Shaanxi; many commanderies often rebelled again—Wulibu attacked and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When Wushi campaigned in Shaanxi and many districts rebelled again, Wulibu attacked and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 敗張浚軍于富平，吾里補先登，睿宗賞以金器名馬。

translations.literal: Defeating Zhang Jun's army at Fupling, Wulibu was first to ascend; Prince Rui rewarded him with gold vessels and a famed horse.
translations.idiomatic: At the defeat of Zhang Jun's army at Fupling, Wulibu was first up the walls. Prince Rui rewarded him with gold vessels and a famed horse.

sentences.zh: 遂以先鋒攻蘭州，下其城。

translations.literal: He then as vanguard attacked Lanzhou and took its city.
translations.idiomatic: He then led the vanguard against Lanzhou and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 加昭武大將軍，授世襲猛安。

translations.literal: He was advanced to General of Illustrious Martiality and appointed hereditary meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to General of Illustrious Martiality and granted a hereditary meng'an.

sentences.zh: 累官孛特本部族節度使，以老致仕，封芮國公。

translations.literal: Rising through offices to military governor of the Bete tribal division, he retired on account of age and was enfeoffed Duke of Rui.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to military governor of the Bete tribal division, retired for old age, and was enfeoffed Duke of Rui.

sentences.zh: 吾里補多智略，膂力過人，雖甚老，勇健不少衰。

translations.literal: Wulibu was full of stratagems, and his physical strength surpassed others; though very old, his courage and vigor declined little.
translations.idiomatic: Wulibu was resourceful and exceptionally strong; though very old, his courage and vigor scarcely waned.

sentences.zh: 大定初，劇賊嘯聚，出特鄙關，吾里補率鄉里年少逆擊之，賊黨遂潰。

translations.literal: Early in Dading, fierce bandits gathered and came out through Tebi Pass; Wulibu led the young men of his district to meet and strike them, and the bandit party then scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Dading, when fierce bandits gathered and broke out through Tebi Pass, Wulibu led the young men of his district against them and put the band to flight.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賞賚甚厚。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the rewards were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, the rewards were lavish.

sentences.zh: 大定二十六年卒，一百有五歲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Dading he died, aged one hundred and five.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-sixth year of Dading, aged one hundred and five.

sentences.zh: 王伯龍

translations.literal: Wang Bolong
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bolong

sentences.zh: 王伯龍，沈州雙城人也。

translations.literal: Wang Bolong was a native of Shuangcheng in Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bolong was a native of Shuangcheng in Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 遼末，聚黨為盜。

translations.literal: At the end of Liao, he gathered a band and became a bandit.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Liao dynasty he gathered followers and turned bandit.

sentences.zh: 天輔二年，率眾二萬及其輜重來降，授世襲猛安，知銀州，兼知雙州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianfu, he led twenty thousand men and their baggage train to submit; he was appointed hereditary meng'an, intendant of Yin Prefecture, and concurrently intendant of Shuang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianfu he led twenty thousand men with their baggage to submit. He received a hereditary meng'an, became intendant of Yin Prefecture, and concurrently intendant of Shuang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年，太祖攻臨潢，伯龍與韓慶和以兵護糧餉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when Taizu attacked Linhuang, Bolong and Han Qinghe guarded provisions with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when Taizu attacked Linhuang, Bolong and Han Qinghe escorted provisions with troops.

sentences.zh: 挽夫千五百人皆授甲，慶和已將兵行前，伯龍從糧居後，遇遼兵五千余邀于路，伯龍率挽夫擊敗之，獲馬五百匹。

translations.literal: Fifteen hundred corvée laborers were all issued armor; Qinghe had already led troops ahead, while Bolong followed the grain train in the rear. They met more than five thousand Liao troops blocking the road; Bolong led the laborers to defeat them and captured five hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen hundred corvée porters were all armed. Qinghe had already marched ahead with troops while Bolong followed behind the grain train. More than five thousand Liao troops blocked the road; Bolong led the porters to defeat them and seized five hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 六年，從攻下中京，並克境內諸山寨，為靜江軍節度留後。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he followed the assault that took Zhongjing and also captured the various mountain stockades within the territory, becoming acting commissioner of the Jingjiang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the capture of Zhongjing and the mountain stockades throughout the region, and was made acting commissioner of the Jingjiang Army.

sentences.zh: 天會元年，真授節度使，從宗望討張覺于平州，伯龍先登馳擊，手殺數十百人，遷右金吾衛將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianhui he was formally appointed military commissioner; following Zongwang he campaigned against Zhang Jue at Pingzhou. Bolong was first to ascend and charge in attack, personally killing many dozens of men, and was transferred to General of the Right Jinwu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianhui he was formally appointed military commissioner. Following Zongwang against Zhang Jue at Pingzhou, Bolong was first over the wall in a cavalry charge and personally killed scores of men. He was made general of the Right Jinwu Guard.

sentences.zh: 白河之戰，伯龍當其左軍，麾兵疾馳蹂之，宋軍亂，我師乘勝奮擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the battle of Baihe, Bolong faced their left army; he commanded troops to charge swiftly and trample them. The Song army fell into disorder, and our forces pressed the advantage and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At the Battle of Baihe Bolong faced the enemy left wing, wheeled his troops into a swift charge through their ranks, threw the Song army into disorder, and the Jin forces pressed the advantage to victory.

sentences.zh: 宗望伐宋，伯龍為先鋒，次保州，遇敵五萬，破之，招降新樂軍民十余萬。

translations.literal: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Bolong served as vanguard; halting at Baozhou, he met fifty thousand enemy troops, defeated them, and induced more than one hundred thousand soldiers and civilians of Xinle to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Bolong served as vanguard. At Baozhou he met fifty thousand enemy troops, routed them, and induced more than one hundred thousand soldiers and civilians of Xinle to submit.

sentences.zh: 大軍圍汴，宋太尉何巉以軍數萬出酸棗門，伯龍以本部遮擊，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: The great army besieged Bianjing; Song Grand Marshal He Shan led tens of thousands of troops out through the Suanzao Gate; Bolong with his command intercepted them and killed or captured many.
translations.idiomatic: As the main army besieged Bianjing, Song Grand Marshal He Shan led tens of thousands of troops out through the Suanzao Gate. Bolong intercepted them with his command and killed or captured many.

sentences.zh: 及破汴，伯龍以治攻具有功。

translations.literal: When Bianjing fell, Bolong had merit in preparing siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: When Bianjing fell, Bolong distinguished himself in preparing the siege equipment.

sentences.zh: 進破孔彥舟、酈瓊眾三萬於洺州。

translations.literal: He advanced to defeat Kong Yanzhou's and Li Qiong's force of thirty thousand at Mingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to defeat the thirty-thousand-strong force of Kong Yanzhou and Li Qiong at Mingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是年，同知保州兵馬安撫司事，將兵數千攻北平，拔之。

translations.literal: That year, as Deputy Commander of Baozhou Military Affairs and Pacification, he led several thousand troops to attack Beiping and took it.
translations.idiomatic: That year, as deputy commander of Baozhou military affairs and pacification, he led several thousand troops against Beiping and captured it.

sentences.zh: 複取保州、河間。

translations.literal: He again recovered Baozhou and Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: He then recovered Baozhou and Hejian.

sentences.zh: 睿宗經略山東，伯龍從攻青州，未下，城中夜出兵襲伯龍營，伯龍不及甲，獨被衣挺刃拒營門，敵不得入，因奮擊殺數十人。

translations.literal: When Prince Rui campaigned in Shandong, Bolong followed the assault on Qingzhou. Before it fell, the city sent troops by night to raid Bolong's camp. Bolong had no time to don armor; clad only in his clothes he took up his blade and barred the camp gate so the enemy could not enter, then fought fiercely and killed dozens.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Rui campaigned in Shandong, Bolong joined the assault on Qingzhou. Before the city fell, its garrison raided his camp by night. Bolong had no time for armor; clad only in his clothes he took up his blade, barred the camp gate, kept the enemy out, and killed dozens in the counterattack.

sentences.zh: 已而軍士皆甲出，殺傷宋兵不可勝計，並獲其一將，斬之。

translations.literal: Presently the soldiers all came out in armor; the Song dead and wounded were beyond counting, and they also captured one of their generals and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his soldiers all came out in armor. The Song dead and wounded were beyond counting, and they captured one of their generals and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 及下青州，第功，伯龍第一。

translations.literal: When Qingzhou fell and merits were ranked, Bolong stood first.
translations.idiomatic: When Qingzhou fell and merits were ranked, Bolong came first.

sentences.zh: 六年，還攻莫州，降之，加太子少保、莫州安撫使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he returned to attack Mozhou, which submitted; he was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Pacification Commissioner of Mozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he returned to attack Mozhou and received its surrender. He was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Pacification Commissioner of Mozhou.

sentences.zh: 破李固寨眾十余萬於濮州。

translations.literal: He defeated the force of more than one hundred thousand at Li Gu Stockade in Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated a force of more than one hundred thousand at Li Gu Stockade in Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 濮城守，城中鎔鐵揮我軍，攻之不能克。

translations.literal: Pu city held firm; within the city they melted iron and hurled it at our army, and the assault could not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Pu held out. The defenders melted iron and hurled it at the Jin army, and the assault could not succeed.

sentences.zh: 伯龍被重甲，首冠大釜，挺槍先登，殺守陴者二十餘人。

translations.literal: Bolong wore heavy armor, his head covered by a great cauldron-helm, and spear in hand was first to ascend, killing more than twenty defenders on the battlements.
translations.idiomatic: Bolong wore heavy armor with a great cauldron-helm on his head, spear in hand, and was first up the wall, killing more than twenty defenders on the parapet.

sentences.zh: 大軍相繼而上，遂克之。

translations.literal: The great army followed in succession and thus took it.
translations.idiomatic: The main force followed in waves and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 進攻徐州，伯龍複先登，充徐、宿、邳三路軍馬都統。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Xuzhou, Bolong again was first to ascend and was appointed overall commander of the Xuzhou, Suzhou, and Pi military routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Xuzhou Bolong again led the ascent and was made overall commander of the Xuzhou, Suzhou, and Pi routes.

sentences.zh: 敗高托山之眾十五萬余於清河。

translations.literal: He defeated the force of more than one hundred fifty thousand under Gao Tuoshan at Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Gao Tuoshan's force of more than one hundred fifty thousand at Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 進擊韓世忠於邳州，走之，與大軍會於宿遷，追世忠至揚州。

translations.literal: He pressed Han Shizhong at Pizhou and drove him off, joined the great army at Suqian, and pursued Shizhong to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed Han Shizhong at Pizhou and drove him off, joined the main army at Suqian, and pursued Shizhong to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 還攻泗州。

translations.literal: He returned to attack Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then turned back to attack Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 泗州守將以城降。

translations.literal: The defender of Sizhou surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The defender of Sizhou surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 屯軍嵫陽，破陳宏賊眾四十余萬。

translations.literal: Encamped at Ziyang, he defeated Chen Hong's bandit force of more than four hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Encamped at Ziyang, he defeated Chen Hong's bandit horde of more than four hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 破黃戩于單州。

translations.literal: He defeated Huang Zhan at Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Huang Zhan at Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 進攻歸德，軍帥遣伯龍立攻具，伯龍從二十餘騎行視地形，城中忽出兵千餘，欲生得伯龍，伯龍縱騎馳之，敵兵亂，墮隍而死者幾二百人。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Guide, the army commander sent Bolong to set up siege equipment. Bolong went with a little more than twenty horsemen to reconnoiter the terrain; suddenly more than a thousand troops came out from the city wishing to capture Bolong alive. Bolong spurred his horse at them; the enemy ranks fell into disorder, and nearly two hundred fell into moats and died.
translations.idiomatic: During the assault on Guide the commander sent Bolong to prepare siege equipment. Bolong rode out with a little more than twenty men to survey the ground when more than a thousand troops suddenly sallied forth hoping to take him alive. He spurred his horse into them; the enemy ranks broke, and nearly two hundred fell into ditches and died.

sentences.zh: 破王善之眾於巢縣，取廬州、和州，伯龍之功多。

translations.literal: He defeated Wang Shan's force at Chao County and took Luzhou and Hezhou; Bolong's merit was great.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Wang Shan's force at Chao County and took Luzhou and Hezhou, with Bolong contributing heavily throughout.

sentences.zh: 軍渡採石，擊敗岳飛、劉立、路尚等兵，獲芻糧數百萬計。

translations.literal: The army crossed Caishi and defeated the troops of Yue Fei, Liu Li, Lu Shang, and others, capturing fodder and grain reckoned in the millions.
translations.idiomatic: The army crossed Caishi, defeated the forces of Yue Fei, Liu Li, Lu Shang, and others, and seized fodder and grain reckoned in the millions.

sentences.zh: 還過真、揚，道遇酈瓊、韓世忠軍，複戰敗之。

translations.literal: Returning through Zhen and Yang, on the road they met the armies of Li Qiong and Han Shizhong and again defeated them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On the return through Zhen and Yang they met the armies of Li Qiong and Han Shizhong and defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 複為莫州安撫，改知澤州。

translations.literal: He again became Pacification Commissioner of Mozhou and was changed to Intendant of Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again became Pacification Commissioner of Mozhou and was made Intendant of Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太行群賊往往嘯聚，伯龍皆平之。

translations.literal: Bandit groups in the Taihang Mountains often gathered in clamor; Bolong pacified them all.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever bandit groups gathered in the Taihang Mountains, Bolong pacified them.

sentences.zh: 天眷元年，為燕京馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianjuan, he was made Commander-in-Chief of the Yanjing Horse Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianjuan he was appointed commander-in-chief of the Yanjing cavalry army.

sentences.zh: 從元帥府複收河南，權武定軍節度使，兼本路都統。

translations.literal: Following the marshal headquarters in recovering Henan, he was acting military governor of Wuding Army and concurrently route commander-in-chief of that circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the marshal headquarters in recovering Henan and was made acting military governor of Wuding Army with concurrent command of that route.

sentences.zh: 宋兵據許州，伯龍擊走之，招複其人民。

translations.literal: Song troops held Xuzhou; Bolong struck and drove them off and induced the people to return.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops held Xuzhou; Bolong drove them off and induced the people to return.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，泰安卒徒張貴驅脅良民，據險作亂，伯龍討平之。

translations.literal: That autumn, the Taian convict Zhang Gui coerced good civilians, seized difficult terrain, and rebelled; Bolong suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Taian convict Zhang Gui coerced civilians, seized defensible ground, and rebelled; Bolong put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，以本部從宗弼南伐，攻破濠州而還。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong he followed his command in Zongbi's southern campaign, took Haozhou, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangtong he followed his command on Zongbi's southern campaign, captured Haozhou, and returned.

sentences.zh: 三年，為武定軍節度使，改延安尹，甯昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was military governor of Wuding Army, changed to Intendant of Yan'an, and military governor of Ningchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he became military governor of Wuding Army, then Intendant of Yan'an and military governor of Ningchang Army.

sentences.zh: 天德三年，改河中尹，徙益都尹，封廣平郡王。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiande he was changed to Intendant of Hezhong, transferred to Intendant of Yidu, and enfeoffed Prince of Guangping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiande he was made Intendant of Hezhong, transferred to Intendant of Yidu, and enfeoffed Prince of Guangping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十五。

translations.literal: He died, aged sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 正隆間，例贈特進、定國公。

translations.literal: During Zhenglong, by precedent he was posthumously granted Special Advancement and Duke of Ding.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenglong, by precedent he was posthumously granted Special Advancement and made Duke of Ding.

sentences.zh: 高彪，本名召和失，辰州渤海人。

translations.literal: Gao Biao, original name Zhaoheshi, was a Bohai man of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Biao, whose original name was Zhaoheshi, was a Bohai from Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖安國，遼興、辰、開三鎮節度使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Anguo was military commissioner of the three garrisons of Xing, Chen, and Kai under Liao.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Anguo had been Liao military commissioner of the three garrisons of Xing, Chen, and Kai.

sentences.zh: 父六哥，左承制，官至刺史。

translations.literal: His father Liuge was Left Director of Manufacture and rose to the office of prefect.
translations.idiomatic: His father Liuge served as Left Director of Manufacture and rose to prefect.

sentences.zh: 彪始生，其父用術者言，為其時日不利於己，欲不舉，其母為營護。

translations.literal: When Biao was born, his father followed a diviner's words that the day and hour were unfavorable to himself and wished not to rear him; his mother protected and cared for him.
translations.idiomatic: When Biao was born, his father, heeding a diviner who said the day and hour were inauspicious for the father himself, wished to abandon the child; his mother protected and raised him.

sentences.zh: 居數歲，竟逐之，彪匿於外家。

translations.literal: After several years he was finally driven out, and Biao hid at his maternal family's home.
translations.idiomatic: After several years his father finally drove him out, and Biao hid with his mother's family.

sentences.zh: 遼人調兵東京時，六哥已老，當從軍，悵然謂所親曰：「吾兒若在，可勝兵矣。」

translations.literal: When the Liao conscripted troops for the Eastern Capital, Liuge was already old and was to join the army; he said sorrowfully to those close to him: "If my son were here, he could match an army."
translations.idiomatic: When the Liao conscripted troops for the Eastern Capital, Liuge was already old and was due to serve. He said sorrowfully to those close to him, "If my son were here, he could match an army."

sentences.zh: 所親具以實告，因代其父行。

translations.literal: Those close to him told him the full truth, and thus he went in his father's place.
translations.idiomatic: His intimates told him the full truth, and he went in his father's stead.

sentences.zh: 戰於出河店，遼兵敗走，彪獨力戰，軍帥見之曰：「此勇土也。」

translations.literal: They fought at Chuhedian; the Liao army was defeated and fled; Biao fought on alone. The army commander saw him and said: "This is a brave warrior."
translations.idiomatic: At Chuhedian the Liao army was defeated and fled, but Biao fought on alone. The army commander saw him and said, "This is a brave warrior."

sentences.zh: 令生致之。

translations.literal: He ordered him taken alive.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered him taken alive.

sentences.zh: 斡魯攻東京，六哥率其鄉人迎降，以為榆河州千戶。

translations.literal: Wolu attacked the Eastern Capital; Liuge led his fellow townsmen in welcoming submission and was made thousand-household chief of Yuhe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Wolu attacked the Eastern Capital, Liuge led his fellow townsmen in submission and was made thousand-household chief of Yuhe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 久之告老，彪代領其眾。

translations.literal: After a long time he reported old age; Biao took over leadership of their following.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time Liuge retired for age; Biao took over command of their following.

sentences.zh: 都統杲攻中京，彪領謀克，從斡魯破遼將合魯燥及韓慶民于高、惠之境。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Gao attacked Zhongjing; Biao led a mouke and, following Wolu, defeated the Liao generals Heluchao and Han Qingmin in the borders of Gao and Hui.
translations.idiomatic: When Commander-in-Chief Gao attacked Zhongjing, Biao led a mouke and, following Wolu, defeated the Liao generals Heluchao and Han Qingmin in the Gao-Hui region.

sentences.zh: 已而駐軍武安，合魯燥以勁兵二萬來襲，從斡魯出戰，與所部皆去馬先登，奮擊敗之。

translations.literal: Presently encamped at Wu'an, Heluchao came with twenty thousand crack troops to raid; following Wolu he went out to battle, and he and his command all dismounted and climbed first, fighting fiercely to defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, encamped at Wu'an, Heluchao came with twenty thousand crack troops to raid. Following Wolu into battle, Biao and his men all dismounted, climbed first, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 奚人負險拒命，所在屯結，彪屢戰有功。

translations.literal: The Xi people relied on rugged terrain and refused orders, gathering in encampments everywhere; Biao repeatedly fought with merit.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi relied on rugged terrain and refused orders, gathering in camps everywhere; Biao fought repeatedly with distinction.

sentences.zh: 宗望攻平州，彪徇地西北道，破敵，招降石家山寨。

translations.literal: When Zongwang attacked Pingzhou, Biao swept the northwest route, defeated the enemy, and induced Shijia Mountain Stockade to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang attacked Pingzhou, Biao swept the northwest route, defeated the enemy, and induced Shijia Mountain Stockade to submit.

sentences.zh: 再從宗望伐宋，為猛安。

translations.literal: Again following Zongwang in the campaign against Song, he served as meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Again following Zongwang against Song, he served as meng'an.

sentences.zh: 師次真定，彪率兵士七十人，臨城築甬道，城中夜出兵焚攻具，彪擊走之。

translations.literal: The army halted at Zhending; Biao led seventy soldiers to build a siege gallery against the walls. The city sent troops by night to burn the siege equipment; Biao drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Zhending. Biao led seventy men to build a siege gallery against the walls. The city sent troops by night to burn the equipment; Biao drove them off.

sentences.zh: 大軍圍汴，以五十騎屯于東南水門。

translations.literal: The great army besieged Bian; with fifty horsemen he was stationed at the southeastern water gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army besieged Bian, he was posted with fifty horsemen at the southeastern water gate.

sentences.zh: 宋人再以重兵出戰，彪皆敗之。

translations.literal: The Song again came out with heavy forces to fight; Biao defeated them all.
translations.idiomatic: The Song again came out with heavy forces; Biao defeated them every time.

sentences.zh: 師還，屯鎮河朔，複破敵於霸州，擒其裨將祝昂。

translations.literal: The army returned and was encamped along the Hebei rivers; again he defeated the enemy at Bazhou and captured their deputy commander Zhu Ang.
translations.idiomatic: On the return the army encamped along the Hebei rivers; he again defeated the enemy at Bazhou and captured their deputy commander Zhu Ang.

sentences.zh: 河間夜出兵二萬襲我營壘，彪率三謀克兵擊敗之。

translations.literal: Hejian sent twenty thousand troops by night to raid our camps and stockades; Biao with three mouke units defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian sent twenty thousand troops by night to raid the Jin camps; Biao with three mouke units defeated them.

sentences.zh: 天會五年，授靜江軍節度使、壽州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianhui he was appointed military governor of Jingjiang Army and Prefect of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianhui he was made military governor of Jingjiang Army and Prefect of Shou.

sentences.zh: 明年，伐宋，從帥府徇地山東，攻城克敵，數被重賞。

translations.literal: The next year, campaigning against Song, he followed the headquarters in sweeping Shandong, storming cities and defeating the enemy, and was repeatedly rewarded heavily.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, campaigning against Song, he followed headquarters in sweeping Shandong, storming cities and defeating the enemy, and was repeatedly rewarded handsomely.

sentences.zh: 七年，師至睢，彪以所部招誘京西人民。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the army reached Sui; Biao with his command induced the people of western Jing to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when the army reached Sui, Biao with his command induced the people of western Jing to submit.

sentences.zh: 次柘城縣，其官吏出降，彪獨與五十餘騎入城。

translations.literal: Halting at Zhecheng County, its officials came out to submit; Biao alone with a little more than fifty horsemen entered the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhecheng County the officials came out to submit; Biao alone entered the city with a little more than fifty horsemen.

sentences.zh: 繼而城中三千餘人複叛，彪率其眾力戰敗之，撫安其民而還。

translations.literal: Presently more than three thousand within the city rebelled again; Biao led his masses to fight fiercely and defeat them, reassured the people, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Soon more than three thousand within the city rebelled again. Biao fought them off, reassured the people, and returned.

sentences.zh: 從梁王宗弼襲康王，至杭州。

translations.literal: Following Prince of Liang Zongbi in the pursuit of Prince Kang, they reached Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Following Prince of Liang Zongbi in pursuit of Prince Kang, they reached Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，宋將韓世忠以戰艦數百扼於江北。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Song General Han Shizhong with several hundred warships blocked the north bank of the river.
translations.idiomatic: On the return, Song General Han Shizhong blocked the north bank with several hundred warships.

sentences.zh: 宗弼引而西，將至黃天蕩，敵舟三十余來逼南岸，其一先至者載兵士二百余。

translations.literal: Zongbi withdrew westward; when they were about to reach Huangtiangdang, enemy boats numbering more than thirty pressed the south bank; the first to arrive carried a little more than two hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Zongbi withdrew westward. Near Huangtiangdang more than thirty enemy boats pressed the south bank; the first to arrive carried a little more than two hundred soldiers.

sentences.zh: 彪度垂及，以鉤拽之，率勇士數十，躍入敵舟，所殺甚眾，餘皆逼死于水中。

translations.literal: Biao judged they were about to reach shore, hooked the boat with a grappling pole, led several tens of brave warriors leaping into the enemy vessel, killed very many, and the rest were all forced into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: Biao judged they were about to land, hooked the boat with a grappling pole, led several tens of warriors leaping aboard, killed many, and drove the rest into the water to drown.

sentences.zh: 明年，從攻陝西，師至寧州，彪與宗人昂率兵三千取廓州。

translations.literal: The next year he followed the attack on Shaanxi; when the army reached Ningzhou, Biao with his clansman Ang led three thousand troops to take Guo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he followed the Shaanxi campaign. When the army reached Ningzhou, Biao with his clansman Ang led three thousand men to take Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 始至，有來降者言：「城東北隅守兵將謀為內應。」

translations.literal: Just after arriving, one who came to submit said: "The garrison troops at the northeast corner of the city are plotting to act as inside collaborators."
translations.idiomatic: Just after arriving, a defector said, "The garrison at the northeast corner of the city is plotting to open the gates from within."

sentences.zh: 彪即夜從家奴二人以登，左右守者覺之，彪與從者皆殊死戰，諸軍繼進，遂克其城。

translations.literal: Biao that night climbed up with two household slaves; the guards on either side noticed them; Biao and his followers all fought to the death; the armies followed in succession and thus took the city.
translations.idiomatic: That night Biao climbed the wall with two household slaves. The guards noticed them; Biao and his followers fought to the death, the main force followed, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 從攻和尚原及仙人關。

translations.literal: He followed the attacks on Heshangyuan and Xianren Pass.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the attacks on Heshangyuan and Xianren Pass.

sentences.zh: 與阿里監護漕糧並戰艦至亳州，宋人以舟五十艘阻河路，擊敗之，擒其將蕭通。

translations.literal: With Ali he escorted grain transport and warships to Bozhou; the Song with fifty boats blocked the river route; he defeated them and captured their general Xiao Tong.
translations.idiomatic: With Ali he escorted grain and warships to Bozhou. The Song blocked the river with fifty boats; he defeated them and captured their general Xiao Tong.

sentences.zh: 擊漣水賊水寨，進取漣水軍，其官民已遁去，悉招降之。

translations.literal: He struck the Lianshui bandits' water stockade, advanced to take Lianshui Army; its officials and people had already fled, and he induced them all to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He struck the Lianshui bandits' water stockade and advanced on Lianshui Army. Its officials and people had already fled; he induced them all to submit.

sentences.zh: 彪勇健絕人，能日行三百里，身被重鎧，歷險如飛。

translations.literal: Biao's courage and vigor surpassed all others; he could travel three hundred li in a day, wore heavy armor, and crossed difficult terrain as if flying.
translations.idiomatic: Biao's courage and vigor were unmatched; he could travel three hundred li in a day, wore heavy armor, and crossed difficult ground as if flying.

sentences.zh: 及臨敵，身先士卒，未嘗反顧，大小數十戰，率以少擊眾，無不勝捷。

translations.literal: When facing the enemy he always led from the front and never looked back; in several tens of battles large and small he always used few to strike many, and there was none in which he did not win with success.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the enemy he always led from the front and never looked back. In several dozen battles, large and small, he usually struck many with few and always won.

sentences.zh: 齊國既廢，攝滕陽軍以東諸路兵馬都統，撫諭徐、宿、曹、單，滕陽及其屬邑皆按堵如故。

translations.literal: After Qi was abolished, he was made overall commander of military affairs east of Tengyang Army, reassuring Xu, Su, Cao, Dan, Tengyang and their subordinate districts so that all remained secure as before.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qi state was abolished, he was made overall commander of military affairs east of Tengyang Army and reassured Xu, Su, Cao, Dan, Tengyang, and their districts so that all remained secure.

sentences.zh: 為武甯軍節度使，頗黜貨，嘗坐贓，海陵以其勳舊，杖而釋之。

translations.literal: He was military governor of Wuning Army and rather grasping in goods; he once sat for corruption, but Hailing because of his old merit beat him and released him.
translations.idiomatic: He was military governor of Wuning Army and rather grasping. He once sat for corruption, but Hailing, because of his old merit, had him beaten and released.

sentences.zh: 改沂州防禦使，曆安化、安國、武勝軍節度使，遷行台兵部尚書，改京兆尹，封郜國公。

translations.literal: He was changed to Defender of Yi Prefecture, successively military governor of Anhua, Anguo, and Wusheng armies, transferred to Minister of War on the Branch Secretariat, changed to Intendant of Jingzhao, and enfeoffed Duke of Gao.
translations.idiomatic: He became Defender of Yi Prefecture, then successively military governor of Anhua, Anguo, and Wusheng armies, Minister of War on the Branch Secretariat, Intendant of Jingzhao, and Duke of Gao.

sentences.zh: 以憂去官，起複為武定軍節度使，歸德尹。

translations.literal: He left office on account of mourning, was recalled to serve as military governor of Wuding Army and Intendant of Guide.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn, was recalled as military governor of Wuding Army and Intendant of Guide.

sentences.zh: 正隆例授金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: By Zhenglong precedent he was granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal.
translations.idiomatic: By Zhenglong precedent he was granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal.

sentences.zh: 久之致仕，複起為樞密副使、舒國公，賜名彪。

translations.literal: After a long time he retired, was again raised as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Duke of Shu, and was granted the name Biao.
translations.idiomatic: After long retirement he was again raised as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Duke of Shu, and granted the name Biao.

sentences.zh: 卒年六十七，諡桓壯。

translations.literal: He died aged sixty-seven; posthumous title Huanzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-seven; his posthumous title was Huanzhuang.

sentences.zh: 彪性機巧，通音律，人無貴賤，皆溫顏接之。

translations.literal: Biao was clever by nature, understood musical pitch, and toward persons high or low always received them with a gentle countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Biao was clever by nature, understood musical pitch, and treated persons high and low alike with a gentle manner.

sentences.zh: 溫蒂罕蒲里特

translations.literal: Wendihan Pulite
translations.idiomatic: Wendihan Pulite

sentences.zh: 溫蒂罕蒲里特，隆州移離閔河胡勒出寨人也。

translations.literal: Wendihan Pulite was a man of Hulechuzhai on the Yilimin River in Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wendihan Pulite was from Hulechuzhai on the Yilimin River in Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 魁梧美髯，有謀略，以智勇聞。

translations.literal: Towering in stature with a handsome beard, he had stratagems and was renowned for wisdom and courage.
translations.idiomatic: Tall and handsome of beard, he was resourceful and renowned for wisdom and courage.

sentences.zh: 都統杲取中京，蒲里特權猛安，領軍五千，遇契丹賊萬餘，與戰敗之。

translations.literal: When Commander-in-Chief Gao took Zhongjing, Pulite acted as acting meng'an and led five thousand troops; he met Khitan bandits numbering more than ten thousand and defeated them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: When Commander-in-Chief Gao took Zhongjing, Pulite acted as acting meng'an and led five thousand troops against Khitan bandits numbering more than ten thousand and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 出袞古里道，敗敵八千餘。

translations.literal: He went out by the Chunguli route and defeated more than eight thousand of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: He went out by the Chunguli route and defeated more than eight thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 至臘門華道，複以伏兵敗敵萬人。

translations.literal: Reaching Lamenhua Road, again with ambush troops he defeated ten thousand of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At Lamenhua Road he again used ambush troops to defeat ten thousand of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 太祖定燕，自儒州至居庸關，執其喉舌人。

translations.literal: When Taizu secured Yan, from Ru Prefecture to Juyong Pass he captured their spokesmen.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu secured Yan, from Ru Prefecture to Juyong Pass he captured enemy spokesmen.

sentences.zh: 有頃，賊三千餘人複寇臘門華道，蒲里特整隊先登，賊識其旗幟，望風而遁，遂奮擊之，親執賊帥。

translations.literal: Before long, more than three thousand bandits again raided Lamenhua Road; Pulite formed ranks and climbed first; the bandits recognized his banners and flags and fled at sight of the wind; he then fought fiercely, personally seizing the bandit chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Before long more than three thousand bandits again raided Lamenhua Road. Pulite formed ranks and led the ascent; the bandits recognized his banners and fled at sight of them. He pursued fiercely and personally seized the bandit chieftain.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，從梁王宗弼伐宋，留軍唐州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong he followed Prince of Liang Zongbi in the campaign against Song and was left with troops at Tang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangtong he followed Prince of Liang Zongbi against Song and was left with troops at Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 敵眾奄至，蒲里特擊之，大名軍萬四千號二十萬，蒲里特率親管猛安，身先士卒，衝擊。

translations.literal: The enemy masses suddenly arrived; Pulite struck them. The Daming Army, fourteen thousand strong, called themselves two hundred thousand; Pulite led the meng'an under his personal charge, took the lead among the troops, and charged.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy masses suddenly arrived and Pulite struck them. The Daming Army, fourteen thousand strong, claimed two hundred thousand. Pulite led the meng'an under his personal charge from the front and charged.

sentences.zh: 敵少卻，乃張左右翼並擊之，敵眾散走。

translations.literal: The enemy retreated somewhat; he then spread the left and right wings and struck together; the enemy masses scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy gave ground slightly; he then spread the left and right wings and struck together, and the enemy scattered.

sentences.zh: 而別遇兵二萬來援，複以兵三千擊走之。

translations.literal: But elsewhere twenty thousand troops came as relief; again with three thousand troops he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Elsewhere twenty thousand troops came as relief; again with three thousand men he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 時邳州土賊嘯聚，幾二十萬，蒲里特軍三千，分為數隊急攻之，賊潰去。

translations.literal: At that time local bandits at Pizhou gathered in clamor, nearly two hundred thousand strong; Pulite with three thousand troops divided into several columns and attacked swiftly; the bandits scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: At that time local bandits at Pizhou gathered, nearly two hundred thousand strong. Pulite with three thousand troops divided into columns, attacked swiftly, and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 南京路遇敵軍二萬，蒲里特以軍三千擊敗之。

translations.literal: On the Nanjing Route he met twenty thousand enemy troops; Pulite with three thousand troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the Nanjing Route he met twenty thousand enemy troops and defeated them with three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 是日，有兵自城中出者，複擊敗之。

translations.literal: That day, troops came out from the city; he again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That day troops sallied from the city; he defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 皇統二年，遷定遠大將軍，同知鳳翔尹。

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangtong he was transferred to General Who Establishes the Far Distant and Deputy Intendant of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangtong he was made General Who Establishes the Far Distant and Deputy Intendant of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 六年，改京兆尹，轉甯州刺史，改西北路招討都監，遷永定軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was changed to Intendant of Jingzhao, transferred to Prefect of Ning, changed to Overall Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Route, and transferred to military governor of Yongding Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he became Intendant of Jingzhao, then Prefect of Ning, Overall Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Route, and military governor of Yongding Army.

sentences.zh: 海陵南征，改武衛軍都總管。

translations.literal: When Hailing campaigned south, he was changed to Overall Commander of the Martial Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: During Hailing's southern campaign he was made Overall Commander of the Martial Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 大定三年，授開遠軍節度使，改泰寧軍。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dading he was appointed military governor of Kaiyuan Army and changed to Taining Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dading he was made military governor of Kaiyuan Army, then of Taining Army.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 十九年，以功授其子兀帶武功將軍、本猛安奚出痕世襲謀克。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, for merit his son Wudai was appointed Martial Merit General and hereditary mouke of the Xichuhen division under the original meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year his son Wudai was appointed Martial Merit General and hereditary mouke of the Xichuhen division for his father's service.

sentences.zh: 伯德特離補

translations.literal: Bode Telibu
translations.idiomatic: Bode Telibu

sentences.zh: 伯德特離補，奚五王族人也，遼禦院通進。

translations.literal: Bode Telibu was a man of the Xi Five Kings clan and a Tongjin of the Liao Imperial Household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Bode Telibu was of the Xi Five Kings clan and had been a Tongjin in the Liao Imperial Household Office.

sentences.zh: 天會初，與父撻不也歸朝，授世襲謀克，後以京兆尹致仕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianhui he returned to the court with his father Tabuye and was appointed hereditary mouke; later he retired as Intendant of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianhui he came over with his father Tabuye, received a hereditary mouke, and later retired as Intendant of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 特離補招降松山等州未附軍民，及招降平州、薊州境內，督之耕作。

translations.literal: Telibu induced the soldiers and civilians of Songshan and other prefectures who had not yet submitted, and within the borders of Ping and Ji induced submission and supervised farming.
translations.idiomatic: Telibu induced unsubmitted troops and civilians of Songshan and other districts, and within Ping and Ji supervised both submission and farming.

sentences.zh: 宗望伐宋，特離補為軍馬猛安，與諸將留，規取保、遂、安三州。

translations.literal: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Telibu served as military meng'an and remained with the generals, planning to secure Bao, Sui, and An prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, Telibu served as military meng'an, remained with the other generals, and planned to secure Bao, Sui, and An.

sentences.zh: 攻安肅軍，河間、雄、保等兵十余萬來救，特離補率所部先戰，大軍繼之，大破其兵，遂拔安肅。

translations.literal: Attacking Ansu Army, more than one hundred thousand troops from Hejian, Xiong, Bao, and elsewhere came to the rescue; Telibu with his command fought first, the great army followed, utterly defeated their troops, and thus took Ansu.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Ansu Army, more than one hundred thousand relief troops from Hejian, Xiong, Bao, and elsewhere arrived. Telibu struck first, the main army followed, routed them, and took Ansu.

sentences.zh: 特離補攝通判事，降將胡愈陰結眾謀亂，特離補勒兵擒愈及其眾五十餘人。

translations.literal: Telibu acted as acting vice commissioner; the surrendered general Hu Yu secretly gathered a crowd to plot rebellion; Telibu led troops to seize Yu and his crowd of more than fifty.
translations.idiomatic: As acting vice commissioner, Telibu learned that the surrendered general Hu Yu was secretly plotting rebellion. He led troops to seize Yu and more than fifty of his followers.

sentences.zh: 安肅軍改為州，就除同知州事。

translations.literal: Ansu Army was changed to a prefecture, and he was appointed on the spot as Deputy Commissioner of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ansu Army was made a prefecture, and he was appointed Deputy Commissioner on the spot.

sentences.zh: 改磁州，捕獲太行群盜。

translations.literal: He was changed to Ci Prefecture and captured bandits of the Taihang group.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Ci Prefecture and captured Taihang bandits.

sentences.zh: 元帥府以磁、相二州屯兵屬之，擒王會、孫小十、苗清等，群盜遂平。

translations.literal: The Marshal's Office placed the garrison troops of Ci and Xiang under him; he captured Wang Hui, Sun Xiaoshi, Miao Qing, and others, and the bandit groups were then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Headquarters placed the Ci and Xiang garrisons under him. He captured Wang Hui, Sun Xiaoshi, Miao Qing, and others, and the bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 遷濱州刺史，廉入優等。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Prefect of Bin; his integrity rating was superior.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Prefect of Bin with a superior integrity rating.

sentences.zh: 以母憂去官，起複本職，改涿州刺史。

translations.literal: He left office on account of mourning for his mother, was recalled to his original post, and changed to Prefect of Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to mourn his mother, was recalled to his former post, and became Prefect of Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 入為工部郎中，從張浩營繕東京宮室。

translations.literal: He entered court as Director of the Works Department and followed Zhang Hao in constructing the Eastern Capital palace halls.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the central government as Director of the Works Department and followed Zhang Hao in building the Eastern Capital palaces.

sentences.zh: 及田玨黨事起，朝省為之一空，特離補攝行六部事，遷大理卿，出為同知東京留守。

translations.literal: When the Tian Jue faction affair arose, the court offices were emptied; Telibu acted in the six departments, was transferred to Grand Judge of the Court of Judicial Review, and went out as Deputy Eastern Capital Defender.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tian Jue faction affair emptied the court offices, Telibu acted for the six departments, became Grand Judge of the Court of Judicial Review, and was made Deputy Eastern Capital Defender.

sentences.zh: 天德三年，複為大理卿，同知南京留守。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiande he again became Grand Judge and Deputy Nanjing Defender.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiande he again became Grand Judge and Deputy Nanjing Defender.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，起複洺州防禦使。

translations.literal: He mourned his father, was recalled, and made Defender of Ming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his father he was recalled as Defender of Ming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正隆盜起，州縣無兵，不能禦。

translations.literal: During Zhenglong, bandits arose and prefectures and districts had no troops and could not resist.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenglong, when bandits arose, prefectures and districts lacked troops to resist.

sentences.zh: 洺舊有河附於城下，特離補乃引水注濠中以為固，盜弗能近，州賴以安。

translations.literal: Ming had an old river attached to the city below; Telibu led water into the moat to strengthen defenses, so the bandits could not approach and the prefecture was thereby secured.
translations.idiomatic: Ming had an old river beside the city wall. Telibu channeled water into the moat for defense so bandits could not approach and the prefecture was saved.

sentences.zh: 遷崇義軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to military governor of Chongyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was made military governor of Chongyi Army.

sentences.zh: 未幾，告老歸田里，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he reported old age and returned to his village fields; he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he retired to his village and died.

sentences.zh: 特離補為人孝謹，為政簡靜不積財，常曰：「俸祿已足養廉，衣食之外，何用蓄積。」
