translations.literal: Telibu as a man was filial and cautious; in government he was simple and quiet and did not accumulate wealth, often saying: "Stipend is already enough to sustain integrity; beyond clothing and food, what use is accumulation."
translations.idiomatic: Telibu was filial and cautious. His government was simple and quiet, and he did not hoard wealth, often saying, "Stipend is enough to sustain integrity; beyond clothing and food, what need is there to accumulate?"

sentences.zh: 凡調官，行李止車一乘、婢僕數人而已。

translations.literal: Whenever he was transferred, his baggage was only one cart and a few servant maids.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he was transferred, his baggage was only one cart and a few servants.

sentences.zh: 耶律懷義

translations.literal: Yelü Huaiyi
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Huaiyi

sentences.zh: 耶律懷義，本名孛迭，遼宗室子。

translations.literal: Yelü Huaiyi, original name Bedie, was a son of the Liao imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Huaiyi, original name Bedie, was of the Liao imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 年二十四，以戰功累遷同知點檢司事。

translations.literal: At twenty-four, through repeated military merit he was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-four, through military merit he rose to Deputy Commissioner of the Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 宗翰已取西京，遼主謀奔于夏，懷義諫止之，不見聽，乃竊取遼主廄馬來降。

translations.literal: Zonghan had already taken the Western Capital; the Liao emperor planned to flee to Xia; Huaiyi remonstrated to stop this but was not heeded; he then secretly took the Liao emperor's stable horses and came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: After Zonghan took the Western Capital, the Liao emperor planned to flee to Xia. Huaiyi remonstrated in vain, then secretly took the emperor's stable horses and defected.

sentences.zh: 太祖自燕還師，留宗翰、斡魯經略西方，懷義領謀克從軍。

translations.literal: When Taizu returned his army from Yan, he left Zonghan and Wolu to manage the western regions; Huaiyi led a mouke and followed the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu withdrew from Yan, he left Zonghan and Wolu to manage the west; Huaiyi led a mouke and followed the army.

sentences.zh: 天會初，帥府以新降諸部大小遠近不一，令懷義易置之，承制以為西南路招討使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianhui the headquarters, because the newly submitted tribes large and small were near and far in disorder, ordered Huaiyi to rearrange them; by imperial appointment he was made Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianhui headquarters, finding the newly submitted tribes scattered near and far, ordered Huaiyi to resettle them and appointed him Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Route.

sentences.zh: 乃擇諸部沖要之地，建城市，通商賈。

translations.literal: He then selected strategic places among the tribes, built cities and towns, and opened trade with merchants.
translations.idiomatic: He chose strategic sites among the tribes, built towns, and opened them to merchants.

sentences.zh: 諸部兵革之餘，人多匱乏，自是衣食歲滋，畜牧蕃息矣。

translations.literal: The tribes, after the turmoil of war, were mostly destitute; from then on food and clothing increased yearly and livestock multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: After the turmoil of war the tribes were mostly destitute; thereafter food, clothing, and livestock steadily increased.

sentences.zh: 從宗翰伐宋，降馬邑，破雁門，屯兵，進攻太原。

translations.literal: Following Zonghan in the campaign against Song, he induced Mayi to submit, broke Yanmen, encamped troops, and advanced to attack Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Following Zonghan against Song, he secured the submission of Mayi, broke Yanmen, encamped, and advanced on Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 以所部別降清源縣徐溝鎮，遂與諸將列屯汾州之境。

translations.literal: With his command he separately induced Qingyuan County and Xugou town to submit, and then with the generals arrayed encampments on the borders of Fen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His command separately secured Qingyuan County and Xugou town, then he camped with the other generals on the Fen Prefecture border.

sentences.zh: 時河東、陝西路兵來救太原，劉光世、折可求柵于文水西山，懷義捕得生口，盡知宋兵屯守要害，乃分兵襲敗之。

translations.literal: At that time troops of the Hedong and Shaanxi routes came to rescue Taiyuan; Liu Guangshi and Zhe Kesou stockaded on the western hills of Wenshui; Huaiyi captured prisoners alive and knew fully the Song troops' encampments and key points; he then divided troops to raid and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: When Hedong and Shaanxi troops came to relieve Taiyuan, Liu Guangshi and Zhe Kesou stockaded on the western hills of Wenshui. Huaiyi took prisoners, learned the Song dispositions, divided his forces, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 明年，再伐宋，從婁室取汾州及其屬邑，遂過平陽，出澤、潞以趨河陽，所至皆降。

translations.literal: The next year, again campaigning against Song, he followed Wushi in taking Fen Prefecture and its subordinate districts, then passed Pingyang, went out through Ze and Lu toward Heyang, and wherever he arrived all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, campaigning again against Song, he followed Wushi in taking Fen and its districts, passed Pingyang, advanced through Ze and Lu toward Heyang, and everywhere met submission.

sentences.zh: 及大軍圍汴，懷義屯京西，汴城既下，宋兵之出奔者，邀擊盡之。

translations.literal: When the great army besieged Bian, Huaiyi was encamped west of the capital; after Bian fell, Song troops who fled out were intercepted and all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army besieged Bian, Huaiyi was posted west of the capital. After the city fell, fleeing Song troops were intercepted and destroyed.

sentences.zh: 從攻鄭、鄧州及討平鄭州叛者，攻下濮州及雷澤縣，從破大名、東平府、徐、兗等州，皆有功。

translations.literal: He followed in attacking Zheng and Deng prefectures and in pacifying Zheng rebels, took Pu Prefecture and Leize County, followed in taking Daming, Dongping Prefecture, Xu, Yan, and other prefectures—all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He helped take Zheng and Deng, pacify rebels in Zheng, capture Pu and Leize, and take Daming, Dongping, Xu, Yan, and other prefectures, distinguishing himself throughout.

sentences.zh: 七年，還鎮。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he returned to his command post.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he returned to his frontier command.

sentences.zh: 十年，加尚書左僕射，改西北路招討使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was advanced to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and changed to Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Route.

sentences.zh: 懷義在西陲幾十年，撫禦有恩，及去，老幼遮道攀戀，數日不得發。

translations.literal: Huaiyi was on the western frontier for nearly ten years; his rule was gracious and he had kindness in pacification and control; when he left, old and young blocked the road clinging to him, and for several days he could not depart.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiyi spent nearly ten years on the western frontier, ruling with grace. When he left, old and young blocked the road in farewell and he could not depart for days.

sentences.zh: 天眷初，為太原尹，治有能聲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianjuan he was Intendant of Taiyuan; his governance had a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Tianjuan he was Intendant of Taiyuan and gained a reputation for capable governance.

sentences.zh: 改中京留守。

translations.literal: He was changed to Central Capital Defender.
translations.idiomatic: He became Central Capital Defender.

sentences.zh: 從宗弼過烏納水，還中京，以老乞致仕，不許。

translations.literal: Following Zongbi across the Wuna River, returning to the Central Capital, he begged to retire on account of old age but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Following Zongbi across the Wuna River, he returned to the Central Capital and asked to retire for age but was refused.

sentences.zh: 改大名尹，命不赴治所，止以俸傔給之。

translations.literal: He was changed to Intendant of Daming and ordered not to go to the seat of government; only his stipend and attendants were given.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Intendant of Daming but need not go to the seat of government; only stipend and attendants were provided.

sentences.zh: 每歲春水扈從，餘聽自便。

translations.literal: Each year at spring flood he attended the imperial hunt; for the rest he was free to do as he pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Each spring he attended the imperial hunt; otherwise he was left to his own devices.

sentences.zh: 明年，再請老得謝，給俸傔之半。

translations.literal: The next year he again requested old age and was dismissed; half his stipend and attendants were given.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he again asked to retire and was dismissed with half stipend and attendants.

sentences.zh: 海陵即位，封漆水郡王，進封莘王。

translations.literal: When Hailing took the throne, he was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery and advanced to Prince of Xin.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing took the throne, he was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui and advanced to Prince of Xin.

sentences.zh: 久之，進封蕭王。

translations.literal: After a long time he was advanced to Prince of Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was advanced to Prince of Xiao.

sentences.zh: 正隆例封景國公。

translations.literal: By Zhenglong precedent he was enfeoffed Duke of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: By Zhenglong precedent he was enfeoffed Duke of Jing.

sentences.zh: 其子神都斡為西北路招討都監，迎侍之官。

translations.literal: His son Shenduwo was Overall Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Route and received him at his official post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shenduwo, Overall Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Route, received him at his post.

sentences.zh: 神都斡從海陵南征，懷義卒於雲中，年八十二。

translations.literal: Shenduwo followed Hailing's southern campaign; Huaiyi died at Yunzhong, aged eighty-two.
translations.idiomatic: Shenduwo followed Hailing south; Huaiyi died at Yunzhong, aged eighty-two.

sentences.zh: 蕭王家奴

translations.literal: Xiao Wangjianu
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Wangjianu

sentences.zh: 蕭王家奴，奚人也，居庫黨河。

translations.literal: Xiao Wangjianu was a Xi man who lived on the Kudang River.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Wangjianu was a Xi who lived on the Kudang River.

sentences.zh: 為人魁偉多力，未冠仕遼，為太子率府率。

translations.literal: As a man he was towering and very strong; before coming of age he served Liao as Commandant of the Crown Prince's Rate Office.
translations.idiomatic: Towering and immensely strong, he entered Liao service before coming of age as Commandant of the Crown Prince's Rate Office.

sentences.zh: 天輔七年，都統杲定奚地，王家奴率其鄉人來降，命為千戶領之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianfu, Commander-in-Chief Gao secured Xi territory; Wangjianu led his fellow townsmen to submit and was ordered to be thousand-household chief commanding them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianfu, Commander-in-Chief Gao secured Xi territory. Wangjianu led his townsmen in submission and was made their thousand-household chief.

sentences.zh: 奚王回離保既死，其親党金臣阿古者猶保撒葛山，王家奴與突撚往討之，生擒金臣阿古者，降其餘眾。

translations.literal: After Xi Prince Huilibao died, his close followers Jinchen Aguzhe still held Sage Mountain; Wangjianu with Tunian went to attack, captured Jinchen Aguzhe alive, and induced the rest to submit.
translations.idiomatic: After Xi Prince Huilibao died, his follower Jinchen Aguzhe still held Sage Mountain. Wangjianu with Tunian attacked, captured him alive, and induced the rest to submit.

sentences.zh: 時平、灤多盜，王家奴以所部屢破賊兵，斬馘執俘，數被賞賚。

translations.literal: At that time Ping and Luan had many bandits; Wangjianu with his command repeatedly broke bandit armies, beheading and capturing, and was repeatedly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Ping and Luan then had many bandits. Wangjianu repeatedly defeated them with his command, taking heads and captives, and was repeatedly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 宗望伐宋，敗郭藥師于白河，亦與有功。

translations.literal: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, he defeated Guo Yaoshi at Baihe and also had merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang campaigned against Song, he helped defeat Guo Yaoshi at Baihe.

sentences.zh: 至河上，宋兵扼津要，與諸將擊敗之。

translations.literal: Reaching the river, Song troops held the crossing; with the generals he defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: At the river Song troops held the crossing; with the other generals he defeated them.

sentences.zh: 進圍汴，破其東門兵。

translations.literal: Advancing to besiege Bian, he broke the eastern gate troops.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to besiege Bian, he broke the eastern gate force.

sentences.zh: 明年，再伐宋，宗望軍至中山，諸門分兵出戰，焚我攻具，祁州、河間各以兵來援，皆敗之。

translations.literal: The next year, again campaigning against Song, Zongwang's army reached Zhongshan; at each gate they sent troops out to fight and burned our siege equipment; Qizhou and Hejian each sent troops in relief—all were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, campaigning again against Song, Zongwang reached Zhongshan. Defenders sallied from each gate and burned Jin siege equipment; Qizhou and Hejian sent relief—all were defeated.

sentences.zh: 師還，屯鎮河朔。

translations.literal: The army returned and was encamped along the Hebei rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The army returned and encamped along the Hebei rivers.

sentences.zh: 濱州賊葛進聚眾數萬臨淄，孛堇照里以騎兵二千討之，王家奴領謀克先登，力戰大破其眾。

translations.literal: The bandit Ge Jin at Bin gathered a crowd of tens of thousands at Linzi; boliezhen Zhaoli with two thousand horsemen attacked; Wangjianu led the mouke in first ascent, fought fiercely, and utterly defeated their masses.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit Ge Jin gathered tens of thousands at Linzi in Bin. Boliezhen Zhaoli attacked with two thousand horsemen; Wangjianu led the mouke in the first ascent and routed them.

sentences.zh: 明年，攻滄州，宋兵拒戰，複從照里擊走之。

translations.literal: The next year, attacking Cangzhou, Song troops resisted; again following Zhaoli he drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, attacking Cangzhou, Song troops resisted; again following Zhaoli he drove them off.

sentences.zh: 宋將徐文以舟百艘泊海島，即以商船十八進襲，斬首七百級，獲舟二十。

translations.literal: Song General Xu Wen with a hundred boats moored at an offshore island; with eighteen merchant boats he advanced to attack, beheading seven hundred heads and capturing twenty boats.
translations.idiomatic: Song General Xu Wen moored a hundred boats at an offshore island. Wangjianu attacked with eighteen merchant boats, beheaded seven hundred, and captured twenty boats.

sentences.zh: 天會八年，除靜江軍節度使，授世襲千戶。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianhui he was appointed military governor of Jingjiang Army and granted hereditary thousand-household status.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tianhui he was made military governor of Jingjiang Army and granted hereditary thousand-household status.

sentences.zh: 從梁王宗弼征伐，為萬戶，還為五院部節度使。

translations.literal: Following Prince of Liang Zongbi in campaign, he served as ten-thousand-household chief; on return he became military governor of the Five Yuan Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Following Prince of Liang Zongbi on campaign he served as ten-thousand-household chief; on return he became military governor of the Five Yuan Divisions.

sentences.zh: 天德二年，改烏古迪烈招討都監，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiande he was changed to Overall Pacification Commissioner of Ugu Dilie and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiande he was made Overall Pacification Commissioner of Ugu Dilie and died.

sentences.zh: 田顥，字默之，興中人。

translations.literal: Tian Hao, courtesy name Mozhi, was a man of Xingzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Hao, courtesy name Mozhi, was from Xingzhong.

sentences.zh: 遼天慶八年進士，曆官金部員外郎，權歸德節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Liao Tianqing he passed the civil service examination; through offices he became Vice Director of the Gold Department and acting military commissioner of Guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Liao Tianqing he passed the civil service examination, rose through offices to Vice Director of the Gold Department, and acted as military commissioner of Guide.

sentences.zh: 太祖定燕，顥舉四州版圖歸朝，加都官郎中，權節度使事，四遷知真定府事。

translations.literal: When Taizu secured Yan, Hao presented the territorial maps of four prefectures in submission; he was advanced to Director of the Court Office and acting military commissioner, and after four transfers became Administrator of Zhending Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu secured Yan, Hao submitted the territorial maps of four prefectures and was made Director of the Court Office and acting military commissioner, later Administrator of Zhending after four promotions.

sentences.zh: 招降齊博、遊貴等賊眾五千餘人。

translations.literal: He induced more than five thousand bandits such as Qi Bo and You Gui to submit.
translations.idiomatic: He induced more than five thousand bandits including Qi Bo and You Gui to submit.

sentences.zh: 已而貴複叛去，顥遣齊博偽叛從貴，因令伺間殺之，降其眾，賊壘悉平。

translations.literal: Presently Gui rebelled again and fled; Hao sent Qi Bo in false submission to follow Gui and ordered him to watch for an opportunity to kill him; he induced the masses to submit, and the bandit stockades were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Gui soon rebelled again. Hao sent Qi Bo to feign submission, watch for a chance to kill him, secure the followers' surrender, and pacify the bandit camps.

sentences.zh: 三遷行台左丞、彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: After three transfers he became Left Vice Director on the Branch Secretariat and military governor of Zhangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became Left Vice Director on the Branch Secretariat and military governor of Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 是時，新定力役，顥蠲籍之半而上之，故相之徭賦比他州獨輕。

translations.literal: At that time corvée labor was newly fixed; Hao remitted half the registered households in reporting upward, and thus Xiang's labor and tax levies were lighter than other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When corvée labor was newly standardized, Hao reported only half the registered households upward, so Xiang's levies were lighter than other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 徙同知河北東路都總管，改同簽燕京留守司事，民遮留不得出，易服夜去。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Deputy Overall Commander of the Hebei Eastern Route; changed to co-signatory of the Yanjing Defender's office; the people blocked the road and he could not leave, so he changed clothes and left by night.
translations.idiomatic: Made Deputy Overall Commander of the Hebei Eastern Route and co-signatory at Yanjing, he was blocked by the people and left by night in disguise.

sentences.zh: 改河東南路轉運使，尋改絳陽軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was changed to Transport Commissioner of the Hedong Southern Route, then soon military governor of Jiangyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: He became Transport Commissioner of the Hedong Southern Route, then military governor of Jiangyang Army.

sentences.zh: 居三年，以疾請謝事，徑解印歸。

translations.literal: After three years he begged to resign on account of illness, directly handed in his seal, and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: After three years he asked to resign for illness, handed in his seal, and went home.

sentences.zh: 數奏不允，移鎮振武軍。

translations.literal: Several memorials were not approved; he was transferred to command Zhenwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Several memorials were denied; he was transferred to command Zhenwu Army.

sentences.zh: 入為刑部尚書，居三月請老，卒於家。

translations.literal: He entered court as Minister of Punishments; after three months he requested old age and died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Minister of Punishments; after three months he asked to retire and died at home.

sentences.zh: 趙隇，字德固，遼陽人。

translations.literal: Zhao Wei, courtesy name Degu, was a man of Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Wei, courtesy name Degu, was from Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 其婦翁以優伶得幸于遼主，隇補閣門祗候，累遷太子左衛率。

translations.literal: His father-in-law, as an actor, gained favor with the Liao emperor; Wei was appointed Attendant of the Palace Gate and rose to Left Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard.
translations.idiomatic: His father-in-law, an actor, gained favor with the Liao emperor. Wei was appointed Attendant of the Palace Gate and rose to Left Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard.

sentences.zh: 後居灤州。

translations.literal: Later he resided at Luan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later he lived at Luan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宗望討張覺，隇逾城出降，授洛苑副使，為灤州千戶。

translations.literal: When Zongwang attacked Zhang Jue, Wei climbed over the wall to come out and submit; he was appointed Deputy Commissioner of the Imperial Parks, and thousand-household chief of Luan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongwang attacked Zhang Jue, Wei climbed over the wall to surrender. He was made Deputy Commissioner of the Imperial Parks and thousand-household chief of Luan.

sentences.zh: 遷洛苑使，檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Imperial Parks and Acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He became Commissioner of the Imperial Parks and Acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 從伐宋，至汴，遷棣州刺史、侍衛步軍都虞候。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Song to Bian, he was transferred to Prefect of Di, and Commandant of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Song campaign to Bian, he was made Prefect of Di and Commandant of the Palace Guard Foot Soldiers.

sentences.zh: 及再伐宋，攻真定，與有功，改商州刺史，檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: When again campaigning against Song and attacking Zhending, he had merit and was changed to Prefect of Shang and Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second Song campaign, attacking Zhending, he distinguished himself and was made Prefect of Shang and Acting Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五年，同知信德府路統押軍兵，兼沿邊安撫司事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was Deputy Overall Commander of the Xinde Route army and concurrently Commissioner of Frontier Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was Deputy Overall Commander of the Xinde Route army and Frontier Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年，權知濟州事。

translations.literal: The next year he acted as Administrator of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he acted as Administrator of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八年，從定河南，授隴州團練使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he followed in securing Henan and was appointed Training Commissioner of Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he helped secure Henan and was made Training Commissioner of Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十年，改知石州。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was changed to Administrator of Shi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was made Administrator of Shi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 隇久在兵間，不善治民，坐謗議，謫監平州甜水鹽。

translations.literal: Wei had long been in the army and was not skilled at governing the people; he sat for slander and criticism and was demoted to supervise sweet-water salt at Ping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Long in military service, Wei was poor at civil governance, sat for slander, and was demoted to supervise sweet-water salt at Ping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 齊國廢，河南皆以宿將守之，授隇宿州防禦使，統本路軍兵。

translations.literal: After Qi was abolished, Henan was all held by veteran generals; Wei was appointed Defender of Suzhou and overall commander of the route's military forces.
translations.idiomatic: After Qi was abolished, Henan was held by veteran generals. Wei was made Defender of Suzhou and overall commander of the route's forces.

sentences.zh: 隇重義，接儒士。

translations.literal: Wei valued righteousness and received Confucian scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Wei valued righteousness and received Confucian scholars.

sentences.zh: 嘗以事至汴，有故人子負官錢百萬，隇以橐金贈之，其子悉為私費，複代輸之。

translations.literal: Once on business he went to Bian; an old friend's son owed the government a million in cash; Wei with money from his purse gave it to him; the son spent it all on private expenses, and Wei again paid it in on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Once on business in Bian, he learned that an old friend's son owed the government a million in cash. Wei gave him the money from his purse; the son spent it all privately, and Wei paid the debt again himself.

sentences.zh: 頃之，有訟徐帥不法者，朝廷使隇鞫治，隇委曲營護，坐是廢罷，寓居於燕。

translations.literal: Before long, someone sued the Xu military governor for unlawful conduct; the court sent Wei to investigate; Wei tactfully protected him, and for this sat dismissed and took lodging in Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon someone sued the Xu military governor for misconduct. The court sent Wei to investigate, but he shielded the man tactfully, was dismissed for it, and took up residence in Yan.

sentences.zh: 海陵出領行台省，至燕，隇往見之，因訴其事。

translations.literal: Hailing went out to head the Branch Secretariat and came to Yan; Wei went to see him and thereupon pleaded his case.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing came to head the Branch Secretariat and reached Yan, Wei went to see him and told his side of the affair.

sentences.zh: 及海陵即位，起為保大軍節度使。

translations.literal: When Hailing took the throne, he was raised to military governor of Baoda Army.
translations.idiomatic: When Hailing took the throne, Wei was recalled as military governor of Baoda Army.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，改內省使。

translations.literal: Early in Zhenyuan he was changed to Commissioner of the Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyuan he became Commissioner of the Inner Palace.

sentences.zh: 未幾，為中都路都轉運使。

translations.literal: Before long he was Overall Transport Commissioner of the Central Capital Route.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made Overall Transport Commissioner of the Central Capital Route.

sentences.zh: 明年，再徙順義、興平，入為太子詹事，鎮沁南，以疾卒，年六十六。

translations.literal: The next year he was again transferred to Shunyi and Xingping, entered court as Tutor of the Heir Apparent, commanded Qinnan, and died of illness, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred again to Shunyi and Xingping, entered court as Tutor of the Heir Apparent, took command of Qinnan, and died of illness at sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 後十餘年，隇子孫、司徒張通古子孫皆不肖淫蕩，破貲產，賣田宅。

translations.literal: More than ten years later, Wei's descendants and Minister Zhang Tonggu's descendants were all unworthy and dissolute, ruined their property, and sold fields and houses.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten years later, the descendants of Wei and of Minister Zhang Tonggu proved unworthy and dissolute, squandered their estates, and sold off fields and houses.

sentences.zh: 世宗聞之，詔曰：「自今官民祖先亡沒，子孫不得分割居第，止以嫡幼主之，毋致鬻賣。」

translations.literal: Shizong heard of this and issued an edict: "From now on, when officials' and commoners' ancestors die, descendants may not divide residential compounds; only the legitimate youngest shall hold them in charge, and must not cause sale."
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong heard of this, he issued an edict: "Henceforth, when an official's or commoner's ancestor dies, descendants may not divide the family residence. Only the legitimate youngest heir shall hold it, and it must not be sold."

sentences.zh: 仍著於令。

translations.literal: It was also written into statute.
translations.idiomatic: The rule was also written into law.
